+---------+                   +-----+                            +----+
| Browser |                   | API |                            | DB |
+----+----+                   +--+--+                            +--+-+
     |                           |                                  |
     | POST /login (credentials) |                                  |
     +-------------------------->|                                  |
     |                           #                                  |
     |                           # Validate input                   |
     |                           +--+                               |
     |                           #  |                               |
     |                           #<-+                               |
     |                           #                                  |
     |                           # SELECT user WHERE email = ?      |
     |                           +--------------------------------->|
     |                           #                                  #
     |                           # User record                      #
     |                           #<.................................+
   + alt User found ------------------------------------------------------+
   | |                           #                                  |     |
   | |                           # Compare password hash            |     |
   | |                           +--+                               |     |
   | |                           #  |                               |     |
   | |                           #<-+                               |     |
   | + alt Password matches --------------------------------------------+ |
   | |                           #                                  |   | |
   | |                           # INSERT session token             |   | |
   | |                           +--------------------------------->|   | |
   | |                           #                                  #   | |
   | |                           # OK                               #   | |
   | |                           #<.................................+   | |
   | |                           #                                  |   | |
   | | 200 OK + JWT              #                                  |   | |
   | |<..........................+                                  |   | |
   | + else Password wrong ---------------------------------------------+ |
   | |                           #                                  |   | |
   | | 401 Unauthorized          #                                  |   | |
   | |<..........................+                                  |   | |
   | +------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
   + else User not found -------------------------------------------------+
   | |                           #                                  |     |
   | | 404 Not Found             #                                  |     |
   | |<..........................+                                  |     |
   +----------------------------------------------------------------------+
     |                           |                                  |
    +-----------------------------+                                 |
    | Subsequent requests use JWT |                                 |
    +-----------------------------+                                 |
     |                           |                                  |
     | GET /profile (JWT)        |                                  |
     +-------------------------->|                                  |
     |                           #                                  |
     |                           # SELECT profile WHERE user_id = ? |
     |                           +--------------------------------->|
     |                           #                                  #
     |                           # Profile data                     #
     |                           #<.................................+
     |                           #                                  |
     | 200 OK + profile JSON     #                                  |
     |<..........................+                                  |
     |                           |                                  |
